description: Aruj Industries Limited was established in 1992 as a public limited company and describes itself as the pioneer of woven fusible interlining manufacturing in Pakistan and the only interlining producer in the country to hold ISO 9000 certification. It runs three divisions: interlining, a continuous dyeing and processing unit installed in 2011, and an apparel division producing fashion garments that it says is SEDEX approved and BSCI compliant with capacity for 200,000 units per month. Its mills and registered office are on Raiwind-Manga Road, Lahore.
headOffice: 2-KM Off Raiwind-Manga Road, Raiwind, Lahore, Pakistan
